scoring_justification: SH-wave reflection and transmission coefficients can be recomputed from public material constants using analytic formulas; compare agent's raw CSV values against the expectation computed from those constants.

hidden_assets.purpose: Material constants (density and shear moduli) for the isotropic base and weld metals used by the reference solution.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Taken from the reference solve.sh, which uses typical literature values for austenitic stainless steel (base: G=73 GPa, weld: G=72 GPa, ρ=7900 kg/m³).
hidden_assets.generation_method: Directly extracted from the solve.sh script.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the exact constants used to compute the reference solution; recomputing from them yields the correct expected curve.

outputs.description: Computed SH-wave reflection coefficient R and transmission coefficient T as functions of incidence angle. The checker will verify that for angles in [45°, 90°] R < 0.1 and T > 0.9.

output_contract.notes: Only the weld interface calculation is included; the cladding interface computation is omitted per taskability scope.
